notes.title: Workshop Update

tags.feature: The workshop is now available in-game, you can customize your jet in the workshop by changing the model and the camouflage.
Now we have SENTINEL's customize parts and PANTHERA UNCIA's camouflage in the workshop, we'll release more camouflage soon.
You'll receive Kármán Coin by open the supply chest, the Kármán Coin can be used to purchase the customized parts or the camouflages.
When selecting a friendly fighter jet, Right-click can switch to the ATTACK Mode;
3D background animation;

notes.title: August patch note
notes.content:
[b] August patch note: [/b]

[list][*] Task system is now online, you can now complete all task to get the new fighter jet: Bishop;[/list]

[list][*] New fighter jet BISHOP：[/list]
[img]https://partner.steamgames.com/gfxproxy/gfx/apps/1331120/extras/Jet_M_preview.png?t=1597918765[/img]
Bishop can deal double damage to the enemy facility, which means it is easy to break the enemy's defense system;

[b]Update list: [/b]
[list][*]This update is targeting to Improve network connection, fix some of the reconnect function issues;[/list]
[list][*]Improve In-game graphics;[/list]
[list][*]Fix the music volumn bar issue;[/list]
[list][*]More after effects has been added to the game;[/list]
[list][*]Fix the issue of enermy can get into the energy field;[/list]
[list][*]Others;[/list]





[u]Previous monthly patch note: [/u]

[u]New In-game mechanism:[/u]

[u]Card Exchange Facility[/u]

After the match begins, the Card Exchange Facility will be deployed to a random location, you can put your cards into this facility to exchange new random cards, you can exchange a maximum of 3 cards at every Exchange facility after you put your cards into the facility, you need to control your fighter jet to collect it, otherwise, the facility will be reset and clear all cards in it at next round.

[u]New fighter jet MIRAGE[/u]

[b]In-game support button[/b]

notes.title: Monthly Update Notes

tags.feature: [b]Card Exchange Facility[/b]After the match begins, the Card Exchange Facility will be deployed to a random location, you can put your cards into this facility to exchange new random cards, you can exchange a maximum of 3 cards at every Exchange facility after you put your cards into the facility, you need to control your fighter jet to collect it, otherwise, the facility will be reset and clear all cards in it at next round.
[b]All new fighter jet MIRAGE:[/b]The attack of MIRAGE will be increased after it was hit.
You can now change your graphic quality in the settings menu.
You can now receive a new player icon every 10 levels.
-Improved in-game graphics;
-User Interface has been updated;
-New in-game background music;
